Author: taio
Name: Mount Scaler
Punchline: Your mount grows and shrinks with your character's height.
Description: Scales the mount you are driving by how much taller or shorter you are than vanilla for your race, clan and height slider, so Penumbra racial scaling mods (and Customize+ / Brio scale) carry over to your mount. You stay your normal size on it. Client-side and visual only: only you see it, and only your own mount is changed.
